title: An octopus had 8 arms and still couldnt run his shop

lines.tts: [intrigued] This octopus had eight arms... and still couldn't keep up.
lines.text: This octopus had eight arms... and still couldn't keep up.

lines.tts: Otto ran the reef's only snack shop. Cooking, cleaning, cash, deliveries, emails, taxes... and one arm just holding his coffee.
lines.text: Otto ran the reef's only snack shop. Cooking, cleaning, cash, deliveries, emails, taxes... and one arm just holding his coffee.

lines.tts: [grumpy, impatient] Excuse me! I've been waiting... FOREVER!
lines.text: Excuse me! I've been waiting... FOREVER!

lines.tts: [dry] Otto was drowning. Which is hard... for an octopus.
lines.text: Otto was drowning. Which is hard... for an octopus.

lines.tts: [hushed, building] So he asked: which jobs actually need me?
lines.text: So he asked: which jobs actually need me?

lines.tts: Only two. The secret recipe... and talking to customers.
lines.text: Only two. The secret recipe... and talking to customers.

lines.tts: [fast, triumphant] The rest? Cleaning: a crab. Deliveries: a schedule. Emails: an auto-reply.
lines.text: The rest? Cleaning: a crab. Deliveries: a schedule. Emails: an auto-reply.

lines.tts: [relieved, happy] I can finally drink my coffee... with TWO hands!
lines.text: I can finally drink my coffee... with TWO hands!

lines.tts: Do the jobs only you can do. Delegate or automate the rest.
lines.text: Do the jobs only you can do. Delegate or automate the rest.

lines.tts: [gruff] Great. Now I want a raise.
lines.text: Great. Now I want a raise.

lines.tts: [friendly] Comment ARMS for the free delegation checklist.
lines.text: Comment ARMS for the free delegation checklist.
